scientific_integrity: A proof and a reproducible exhaustive small-case verifier are supplied; no publication-priority guarantee or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian underlying group must have odd order.
Coefficient characteristic must be coprime to the group order.
No even-order, modular, or general Alexander-quandle classification is claimed.
The finite-field distribution is a new rational-point calculation built from established Fourier equations; broader prior coverage remains a possible risk.
title: Finite-field Galois descent for idempotents of odd-order core-quandle algebras
